LAYER 3 — AI / ML MULTI-EVIDENCE ANALYSIS LAYER (Parallel Inference)

g.text: LAYER 4 — TEMPORAL INTELLIGENCE (GRU State Recurrence Engine)
Rolling Threat State Tracker: h_t = GRU(h_{t-1}, x_t)
Evidence accumulates monotonically under sustained threat: t1 (22) → t2 (58) → t3 (84) → t4 (94 CRITICAL)
LAYER 5 — MULTI-EVIDENCE FUSION & DYNAMIC RISK ENGINE
FINAL RISK = MULTI-EVIDENCE SIGNALS (Voice + Speaker + Intent + Tactics) + TEMPORAL HISTORY + CALLER CONTEXT
CRITICAL PRINCIPLE: SYSTEM NEVER MAKES A SECURITY DECISION FROM A SINGLE DEEPFAKE MODEL OUTPUT ALONE
LAYER 6 — DETERMINISTIC DECISION & POLICY ENGINE (Rule-Based Policy Enforcement)
Automated Call Protection Recommendation + Emergency Family SOS Dispatch
LAYER 7 — ANDROID EXPERIENCE & COMMAND CENTER DASHBOARD
• Data Minimization: Raw audio is processed ephemerally in RAM and immediately discarded; zero raw call audio is saved to disk.
• Biometric Consent: 192-d speaker embeddings are encrypted and stored only with explicit user consent.
• Storage Separation: Ephemeral state lives in Redis (30-min TTL); persistent audit metadata lives in PostgreSQL / SQLite.
• Tamper Evidence: SHA-256 Frame Hash Chains
